title: 第七章 底蕴尽出第八章 熟悉的时代发展
content_zh:
这几日气氛越加的凝重，村民各自都开火，该吃吃该喝喝，调养好了身体，吃饱了肚子好应对以后发生的事情。
一直到事情的前一天。
宋风开完土地弄完石头之后，没有搭理其他人，只一个人背着手慢悠悠的来到了这高山村，其中一处看起来比较古旧的破房子前。
淡青色的道袍在日光下显得分外淳朴。
轻轻挽一挽袖子，隐约间看起来好像有着丝丝缕缕的尘土在飘扬，宋风脸上一脸平静淡然就这样走进了这老旧房子里面。
“咚咚咚~”
轻轻敲门进去。
等到宋风走进去时，便见到里面有几个穿着古朴，但是却佝偻着身子的几个老头，仔细数去一共五人。
看到宋风背着双手跟个小老头似的走进来，其中那头上戴着蒙头巾看起来是其中老大的那老头则是轻咳几声:
“该来的都已经来了，关门闭户。”
就在这老头话语落下，只看到门前夹角处一个看不清的角落中，突然走出来两个壮汉，随即在外面关上门不留丝毫的光线进入。
房屋中央点着一团篝火。
隐约间，似乎都照不清这几个老头子的面目，让他们在烟雾之中看起来分外朦胧，看不清究竟是什么样的表情。
宋风依次进入座位，在几个人附近找到了最后一个木头凳子坐下，也是安然平静并不发表一言。
几个老头抽着土烟袋，吧嗒吧嗒几声之后，便看到带头的那老头子轻咳几声，随即看了一眼在场之中的众人:
“家里的小的们都已经送出去了没？”
听到了老大这话，其他几个老头则是纷纷点头，看起来似乎是早就已经熟悉了这种事情。
然而等到宋风的时候，他则是在几个老头的注目之下缓缓的摇了摇头，随即面色平静的开口道:
“求真观一共我们师徒三人，另外两个小的也没学到什么真本事，送出去还不如留在这里也免得徒生波澜。”
听到了宋风如此说，在场之中的那几个老头抽烟的抽烟喝水的喝水，但无一例外，那浑浊的老眼中看起来都在思索些什么。

就在这个时候。
只看到那抽着旱烟袋的老大重重看了宋风几眼，随即在火堆之中扒出来几个红薯呲着一口黄牙，一边笑着一边剥开咬了一口:
“别看老宋头单枪匹马，但这老东西身子骨最硬也最狡猾，求真观的那两个小娃娃没走，那说明咱们高山村的日子是真要好起来了，好啊好啊……”
听到了老大如此说，其他几个老头看了一眼面色沉静，并没有表现出其他动作姿态的宋风也是各自点头。
一时间，整个老房子里突然变得平静下来，只有几个老头子吃红薯的声音不断地传了出来，烟火气笼罩，只觉得房间之中如梦似幻。
“咔嚓！”
木头门从外面被打开，带着几缕烟火气，宋风挥了挥大袖背着身子看起来就跟高楼的小老头似的，施施然的从房门内走出。
看着宋风离去的身影。
剩下的几个小老头也没怎么动作，只是任凭烟气向外飘散而出，等到烟气清明房间之中看得清环境时，这才听到几个老头中有人开口道:
“既然老宋头都觉得这件事情是个机遇，那就安排家里的几个孩子都回来吧，人多了终究也是热闹，山洞那嘎达的又湿又冷别伤着孩子。”
就在这几个老头决定之后，只看到一直守护在这几个老头身后的那两个壮汉则是点了点头，几个老头子也是各自佝偻着身子各回各家了。
content_en:
The atmosphere has become more solemn in the past few days, and the villagers are all firing up, eating and drinking when they should, taking care of their bodies and filling their stomachs to cope with what will happen in the future.
Until the day before the incident.
After Song Feng finished digging the land and getting the rocks, he didn't pay attention to anyone else. He walked slowly to the mountain village alone, with his hands behind his back, in front of one of the old-looking broken houses.
The light blue Taoist robe looks particularly simple in the sunlight.
Gently rolling up his sleeves, it seemed as if there were wisps of dust floating in the air, Song Feng walked into the old house with a calm and indifferent look on his face.
"Dong dong dong~"
Knock gently and go in.
When Song Feng walked in, he saw a few old men in simple clothes but with hunched bodies. He carefully counted five people in total.
Seeing Song Feng walking in like a little old man with his hands behind his back, the old man wearing a turban on his head who seemed to be the boss coughed a few times:
"Everything that is supposed to come has already come. Close the doors."
Just as the old man finished speaking, he saw two strong men suddenly walking out of an unclear corner in front of the door, and then closed the door outside without letting in any light.
A bonfire was lit in the center of the house.
Vaguely, it seemed that the faces of these old men could not be clearly illuminated, making them look extremely hazy in the smoke, and it was not clear what their expressions were.
Song Feng entered the seats one by one and found the last wooden stool near several people and sat down. He was calm and did not say a word.
Several old men were smoking pipes, and after a few clicks, they saw the old man taking the lead coughing a few times, and then glanced at everyone present:
"Have all the little ones at home been sent out?"
After hearing what the boss said, the other old men nodded one after another, as if they were already familiar with this kind of thing.
However, when Song Feng arrived, he slowly shook his head under the attention of several old men, and then said calmly:
"There are three of us masters and disciples in the Qiuzhen Guan. The other two little ones haven't learned any real skills. It's better to stay here and avoid trouble as disciples if we send them out."
After hearing what Song Feng said, the old men present smoked and drank, but without exception, they seemed to be thinking about something in their muddy old eyes.
At this time.
I only saw the boss smoking a dry tobacco pipe giving Song Feng a few serious glances, then he took out a few sweet potatoes from the fire, bared his yellow teeth, and peeled them open while smiling and took a bite:
"Although Old Songtou is acting alone, this old guy is the toughest and most cunning. The two little ones who seek truth are still here, which means that life in our mountain village is really going to get better. Okay, okay..."
After hearing what the boss said, the other old men glanced at Song Feng, who had a calm expression and showed no other movements, and nodded their heads.
For a moment, the whole old house suddenly became quiet. Only the sound of a few old men eating sweet potatoes could be heard continuously. The smoke of fireworks enveloped the room, making the room feel like a dream.
"Crack!"
The wooden door was opened from the outside, with a few wisps of smoke and smoke. Song Feng waved his sleeves and looked like a little old man in a high-rise building, and walked out of the door calmly.
Watching Song Feng leave.
The remaining little old men didn't do much, just letting the smoke drift out. When the smoke was clear and the room could see the environment clearly, they heard one of the old men say:
"Since Lao Songtou thinks this matter is an opportunity, let's arrange for the children at home to come back. It will be lively after all if there are too many people. The cave is wet and cold, so don't hurt the children."
Just after these old men made their decision, they saw the two strong men who had been guarding behind these old men.After nodding, the old men hunched over and went back to their homes.
